India-England ODI at Lord's sees player tributes, historic batting, and celebrity attendance

During the third ODI between India and England at Lord's on July 19, players from both teams wore black armbands and observed a minute of silence to pay tribute to Sir Garfield Sobers. Rohit Sharma achieved a historic ODI century at Lord's, becoming the oldest Indian to do so in the format. England posted a total of 387 runs. Notably, fast bowler Jasprit Bumrah was unavailable due to a knee injury. The match also saw attendance from Bollywood celebrities and former cricketers.
